name: Yakata
source:
Michie, Saki, and Erika stories are available from the main menu. Each story tells how girl's love life settled after the struggle over the mansion.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-august-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主菜单可进入美智惠、沙纪和绘里香的故事。每个故事都讲述女孩经历围绕宅邸的争斗后，爱情生活如何尘埃落定。
